title: Cutover lattice with stochastic shadow rehearsal and dry-run rollbacks
author: Priya Rao
release_notes: Introduces a staged cutover lattice with stochastic shadow rehearsals and a dry-run rollback simulator. Adds new rollout v2 config, observability hooks, and a migration guide for existing canaries. Impact: rollout behavior change behind feature flag; no immediate user-visible changes.
description: Context: We observed hard-to-reproduce regressions that only appear under production mixing of shadow and real traffic. This PR implements a cutover lattice controller that coordinates small, tiered canaries, runs stochastic shadow rehearsals (sampled deterministic perturbations on live traffic routed to shadow paths), and exposes a dry-run rollback simulator for policy tuning. Motivation: improve detect-and-revert velocity for flaky regressions while keeping blast radius low. Approach: 1) New lattice controller (rollout/v2) that composes tiered canaries with explicit holdpoints and stochastic triggers. 2) Replayable shadow pipeline: captured requests + deterministic perturbation seeds allow fast local replay and cross-checks against gold metrics. 3) Dry-run rollback simulator that runs candidate rollback policies against recent telemetry windows to estimate false-positive/false-negative tradeoffs before taking real action. 4) Telemetry and tracing: per-slice provenance tags, deterministic pseudo-random seeds, and a new "shadow_rehearsal" metric family. 5) Migration and safety: rollout is behind a feature flag (rollout.v2.enabled) and has a conservative default policy; added canary timeouts and manual gate APIs for on-call intervention. Implementation notes: added orchestrator lattice, simulator harness, e2e smoke that uses synthetic workload driver, and docs/runbooks with playbooks and migration steps. Backwards compatibility: controllers fall back to rollout/v1 when the feature flag is disabled. Testing: unit tests, an integration harness that replays stored traces, and a performance microbenchmark to ensure controller scheduling overhead stays <5% of current path. Checklist: - [x] Lattice controller implementation - [x] Replay capture and replay tool - [x] Dry-run simulator with policy evaluation - [x] Metrics, tracing and dashboards - [x] Migration docs and runbooks - [x] E2E smoke tests and CI updates - [x] Feature-flag gating and toggle in console

review_comments: Liam O'Connor: Nice design. Two high-level asks: (1) can we add a short-circuit so the simulator doesn't run against >12h windows by default? (2) add a note in the migration doc about cached KV behavior for old agents.
Priya Rao: Reply: added a simulator window cap (default 6h configurable) and a migration subsection about KV cache draining; see docs/runbooks/rollouts_v2_migration.md (commits f44c99b and earlier).
Hannah Lee: Can you add an e2e that verifies the deterministic seed yields identical replays across hosts? Will we need a compatibility shim?
Priya Rao: Added simulator_test with cross-host replay verification and a compatibility shim layer in replay_replayer.go; test passes locally.
Marcus Rivera: Observability looks good but we should avoid high-cardinality tags on every request — ensure 'shadow_rehearsal_variant' is sampled at 1% by default.
Priya Rao: Set default sample rate to 1% and added config rollout.observability.shadow_rehearsal_sampling to console toggle.
ci_details: CI pipeline: unit -> integration -> e2e-smoke -> perf. First run (2026-02-12) failed on e2e-smoke (timeout in replay_replayer), re-ran after fix for cross-host sequencing; second run (2026-02-14) passed all stages. Perf microbenchmark shows controller scheduling + simulator overhead +4.2% median; within target (<5%). Coverage: +6% in orchestrator package.
merge_summary: Merged by squash on 2026-02-18 after approvals from Liam and Hannah. Merge commit contains consolidated change list and migration docs. Feature gated behind rollout.v2.enabled; rollout.v2 default behavior is off in prod until ops enables it for pilot tenants.
notes_for_ops: Ops: enable rollout.v2.enabled=false by default. For pilot: set rollout.v2.enabled=true for a single tenant namespace and set rollout.observability.shadow_rehearsal_sampling=0.01. If simulator indicates high false positives, tune policy thresholds via console or set rollout.v2.autobackout=false to require manual intervention.
risk_assessment: Low-medium: controller is feature-flagged and will not alter production traffic unless rollout.v2.enabled=true. Simulator only reads telemetry by default and supports dry-run. Potential risk: accidental enablement could increase metrics cardinality; mitigated by default sampling and operator toggles.
migration_steps: 1) Ensure all agents upgraded to >=v0.23.2 which includes replay_replayer compatibility shim. 2) Flip rollout.v2.enabled in staging only and run replay-sim against recent 2h windows. 3) Validate dashboards and smoke tests. 4) Gradually enable for pilot tenants and monitor rollback_simulator metrics before broad enablement.
